in_marathi.name: Kaveri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the River Kaveri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaveri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kaveri is the goddess of the Kaveri River. She is worshipped as the goddess of water and fertility. The river is believed to originate from her feet.
